# Hair Haven Extension Lounge

> Extensions, color & lashes based in Bloomington, Indiana. Fusion, tape-in and sew-in extensions, healthy blondes, curly cuts and wispy lash sets from Samantha Ellis and her team, in a flower-wall salon on N Walnut St in Bloomington.

## Services
- Hair extensions: Fusion, tape-in and sew-in extensions, colored to blend with your own hair and installed by Samantha.
- Color & balayage: European color, from soft dimension to dark-to-blonde transformations and rich reds.
- Cuts & curly cuts: Specialized curly cuts, layers and fresh shapes, with real experience in textured hair.
- Nanoplastia smoothing: A smoothing treatment that takes frizz down for sleek, glossy hair.
- Lash extensions: Wispy sets by Grace Gorman, a 2x certified lash artist with 4 years of experience.
- Bridal hair & makeup: Wedding-day hair and makeup, plus makeup application and lessons.

## About
Hair Haven Extension Lounge is Samantha Ellis's salon at 811 N Walnut St in Bloomington, just north of downtown. You'll know it by the flower wall and the pink neon sign that reads "love is in the hair". Clients say Samantha takes the time to listen first, puts nerves at ease, and sends them home with the products and tips to keep their hair looking the way it did in the chair. Reviewers also mention her experience with textured and curly hair, which can be hard to find, and that everyone at the salon makes them feel welcome. Lash extensions are done by Grace Gorman, Jackie Trejo takes cuts, color and balayage clients, and Carrie Temple offers esthetic services. In the salon's own words, the mission is that each client walks out feeling more confident than when they walked in.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book at Hair Haven?
  A: Book online with Samantha, Grace or Jackie through Hair Haven's Vagaro page, or call (270) 599-5053. For esthetic services, call Carrie Temple directly at (310) 733-9622.
- Q: Which hair extensions do you offer?
  A: Fusion, tape-in and sew-in extensions, plus extension color, removal and reapplying. Samantha can help you choose the method that suits your hair.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Tuesday 9 to 5, Wednesday and Thursday 9 to 7, Friday and Saturday 9 to 3. Closed Sunday. Appointments are recommended.
- Q: Do you work with curly and textured hair?
  A: Yes. Hair Haven offers specialized curly cuts, and clients mention Samantha's experience with textured hair.
- Q: Do you do lash extensions?
  A: Yes. Grace Gorman does classic, hybrid, volume, mega volume and wispy lash sets. New lash clients pay a small deposit that goes toward the appointment.
- Q: What is the cancellation policy?
  A: Please give at least 24 hours notice to cancel. Late cancellations carry a fee of 50% of the service, applied before your next booking.
